originalAlarm.description: Dereference of null pointer (loaded from variable 'ops')

presenceCondition:
(or (and CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN (not CONFIG_OF_IRQ))
    (and CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE (not CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN) (not CONFIG_OF_IRQ)))
model:
(define-fun CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN () Bool
  false)
(define-fun CONFIG_OF_IRQ () Bool
  false)
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE: When CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE is defined, it also defines CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN via the #define inside the #ifdef. In twl_probe(), ops is initialized to NULL and only set to &irq_domain_simple_ops inside #ifdef CONFIG_OF_IRQ. When !CONFIG_OF_IRQ, ops remains NULL when passed to irq_domain_add(), which dereferences it at line 12 ('int irq = *ops'). KNOWN BUG: The vbdb entry for 6252547b8a7.c documents exactly this NullDereference bug for TWL4030_CORE && !OF_IRQ. The presence condition (which simplifies to TWL4030_CORE && !OF_IRQ in both variants) matches the vbdb config. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: The condition correctly identifies the configuration where ops is NULL when irq_domain_add is called.
